title: Vacuum pump-down with staged roughing / high-vacuum valves
nl_spec: A vacuum chamber is evacuated through two lines selected by chamber Pressure (in mbar, 1000 = atmosphere, 0 = high vacuum). While pumping down and Pressure is above the crossover P_CROSS = 100 (illustrative; real systems are pump-specific, often 1-10 mbar), the RoughValve (roughing line) is open. Once Pressure falls to P_CROSS or below, the RoughValve closes and the HiVacValve (high-vacuum/backing line) opens. (A real high-vacuum readiness interlock - e.g. proving foreline/backing pressure before committing to the high-vacuum line - is out of scope for this easy task.) The two pump valves must NEVER be open at the same time (cross-connection would backstream oil into the chamber). A VentCmd opens the VentValve to atmosphere, and while venting both pump valves are closed; the vent valve must never be open together with either pump valve. Pumping runs only while StartPump is TRUE. EStop is the emergency stop, normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated); when activated all three valves close (isolate). Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named vacuum_pumpdown with inputs Pressure, StartPump, VentCmd, EStop and outputs RoughValve, HiVacValve, VentValve.

interface.name: Pressure
interface.description: Chamber pressure in mbar (1000 = atm, 0 = high vacuum)

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: On emergency stop (EStop = FALSE), all valves are closed.
The roughing and high-vacuum valves are never open at the same time (crossover protection).
The vent valve is never open together with either pump valve.
The high-vacuum valve only opens at or below the crossover pressure.
Positive obligation: a healthy vent request drives the vent valve open.

scenarios.description: Vent request opens only the vent valve

notes: DRAFT - pending expert PLC review. NEW FAMILY: staged evacuation valve-lineup with a crossover / cross-connection interlock. Primary structure is a pressure-region-selected valve line-up with a physical-cross-connection prohibition (rough vs high-vacuum) plus a vent isolation prohibition - not a two-output mutual-exclusion latch and not hysteresis. Combinational, no timer, no counter.
